title: No Religion Now Covers 28% Of Americans—More Than Catholics
hook: No religion now describes 28% of Americans, passing Catholics.
closing: Generational replacement could reshape churches, communities, and public life.
question: Do you consider yourself religious?

segments.say: No religious affiliation reached 29 percent. What was once unusual has become mainstream.
Among millennials, 36 percent report no religion. Younger adults are driving the shift.
Unaffiliated adults now make up 28 percent. That puts no religion ahead of Catholicism.
